services.name: Ticket
services.desc: An iconic musical of a generation, RENT is set in New York City’s East Village during the 1990s bohemian revolution. The notorious lovers come to blazing life in Bonnie & Clyde, a thrilling musical about ambition, fame, and forbidden romance. Lightwire Theater brings the classic fable of the slow and steady Tortoise and the nimble but overconfident Hare to dazzling life. This magical panto from the Lythgoe Family brings the classic tale of Aladdin to life with a festive twist, featuring hit pop songs, laugh-out-loud comedy, and show-stopping dance

services.name: School Programs
services.desc: From in-school musical theatre productions to field trips that introduce students to live performance, Laguna Playhouse’s education programs make the arts accessible to young people throughout the region. Laguna Playhouse brings musical theatre directly to school campuses, giving elementary and middle school students the chance to rehearse and perform full productions guided by industry professionals. Theatre Reach is Laguna Playhouse’s award-winning program that invites students from across Orange County to experience the magic of live, professionally staged theatre at the Playhouse. ©2026 Laguna Playhouse - a tax-exempt 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization - EIN 95-1509841.
